title: Reissert compound studies. XXXIV. Base‐catalyzed reactions of the phthalazine reissert compound
abstract: AbstractThe phthalazine Reissert compound has been used to convert phthalazine to 1‐benzylphthalazines, bisbenzylphthalazines, 1,4‐disubstituted phthalazines, 1‐cyanophthalazine, and a number of other phthalazine derivatives including the tricyclic compound 14.
